metadata.description: Comprehensive feature inventory categorized by Core/Content/Util for client and server implementation

core.description: Essential systems required for basic Minecraft functionality

terrainGeneration.name: Base Terrain Generation
terrainGeneration.description: Base terrain heightmap generation using Perlin/Simplex noise
terrainGeneration.implementationNotes: Uses Simplex noise for natural terrain generation with configurable parameters

caveGeneration.name: Cave Generation
caveGeneration.description: Advanced cave algorithms with natural formations
issues: Cave-river-lake coupling needs seasonal runoff weighting
caveGeneration.implementationNotes: Uses 3D noise for cave tunnel generation. Needs stability checks and liquid features.

riverGeneration.name: River Generation
riverGeneration.description: Realistic river flow patterns and bank erosion
issues: River carving needs flow direction calculation
River bank erosion not fully implemented
riverGeneration.implementationNotes: Uses gradient descent for flow direction. Needs erosion and delta features.

lakeGeneration.name: Lake Generation
lakeGeneration.description: Varied lake sizes with shoreline enhancement
lakeGeneration.implementationNotes: Creates lakes in terrain depressions. Needs depth variation and shoreline blending.

biomeGeneration.name: Biome Generation
biomeGeneration.implementationNotes: System exists but not fully implemented. Needs integration with terrain generation.

oreDistribution.name: Ore Distribution
oreDistribution.implementationNotes: Basic ore distribution exists. Needs clustering and depth-based distribution.

terrainPipeline.name: Terrain Generation Pipeline
terrainPipeline.implementationNotes: Pipeline coordinates all terrain generation stages. Supports seasonal runoff.

protobufProtocol.name: Protobuf Protocol
issues: Mixed use of protobuf-net and Google.Protobuf
protobufProtocol.implementationNotes: Uses Google.Protobuf. Need to verify all packet references and handlers.

messageHandlers.name: Message Handlers
issues: Many protocol messages defined but not handled
messageHandlers.implementationNotes: Handler system exists but not all messages are handled.

networkTransport.name: Network Transport
networkTransport.implementationNotes: TCP transport implemented. Supports reconnection and error handling.

connectionManagement.name: Connection Management
connectionManagement.implementationNotes: Basic session management exists. Need reconnection and heartbeat.

networkCompression.name: Network Compression
networkCompression.implementationNotes: Chunk compression exists but not integrated with network.

worldMapController.name: World Map Controller
worldMapController.description: Server and client world map control
worldMapController.implementationNotes: Controllers exist on both sides. Need better synchronization and budget alignment.

chunkSynchronization.implementationNotes: Chunk sync exists but needs validation and diff-based updates.

worldSynchronization.name: World Synchronization
worldSynchronization.implementationNotes: Sync coordinators exist for blocks, chunks, and entities.

waterPhysics.implementationNotes: System exists but not fully implemented.
